overview_description.description:
Terrain offers the world’s first Algorithm Management Platform for e-commerce organizations.  Terrain offers a self-service approach to building, testing, deploying and optimizing e-commerce channels.  Users of Terrain get more clicks, conversions, and revenue with AI assisted merchandising, self-learning search, email personalization, and dynamic feed optimization.

Terrain was founded in 2015 by Mike Agnich and Charles Tripp.  They noticed that many e-commerce professionals were struggling to implement algorithms to better manage their e-commerce channels.  While the marketers and channel managers knew what steps they needed to take to improve channel performance, they found that much of the technical capability required to optimize e-commerce offers were held by the IT teams.  Consequently, projects took longer, cost more and had a lower likelihood of succeeding than was ideal.

Today, Terrain’s mission is to put algorithm success in the hands of e-commerce managers and marketers so they can drive improved performance, higher conversions and more profitability.  

Our customers are seeing 5% - 20%+ improvements in key e-commerce conversion metrics, and are developing powerful new processes that allow them to challenge the most advanced competitors in their industries.
